dog.description_text: This cutie resides at our Westhampton location If you are interested in meeting them, you must click "Apply for Adoption" to submit an online application. If you're viewing this animal on Petfinder, please visit the animal's page on Bideawee.org and click on the "Apply for Adoption" button to submit an adoption application. Prior to adoption, all of our animals are spayed/neutered, microchipped and given their age-appropriate vaccines
